requirements.title: Password and OTP login
requirements.description: Admin and Assigned Person log in to the web panel with a password plus OTP.

requirements.title: Admin dashboard metrics
requirements.description: The dashboard shows complaints by project, category and status, delays, approved residents vs total flats, family and member totals, owner vs tenant flats, and live facility counts.

requirements.title: Unlimited project hierarchy setup
requirements.description: Admin can set up any number of projects, buildings, floors and flats.

requirements.title: Per-project amenity setup
requirements.description: Admin can add any amenity per project as Bookable (hall) or Shared (gym, pool), with capacity, open hours, slot length and rules.

requirements.title: Create staff with project access
requirements.description: Admin can create staff and give them access to selected projects.

requirements.title: Manage committee members and permissions
requirements.description: Admin can create, replace or deactivate committee members and give or remove permissions.

requirements.title: View residents across projects
requirements.description: Admin can view owners and tenants across projects in a view-only list.

requirements.title: Configure complaint categories
requirements.description: Admin can set category, builder or society responsibility, time limits, default Assigned Person and reminder days.

requirements.title: Admin complaint handling across projects
requirements.description: Admin can view, assign, reassign and override complaints across projects.

requirements.title: Assigned Person task updates
requirements.description: Assigned Person can mark own complaints as Work Started or Fixed with photo.

requirements.title: Post notices to projects
requirements.description: Admin can post announcements, celebrations and events to all or selected projects.

rules.title: Resident list is view only
rules.description: The resident list of owners and tenants can only be viewed, not edited.

rules.title: Assigned Person sees own complaints only
rules.description: In My Tasks, an Assigned Person can see and act on only their own complaints.
